queer_characters.name: Abigail
queer_characters.notes: A grieving frontier farmwife married to Dyer who falls in love with her neighbor Tallie; their bond evolves into an explicit physical affair. Portrayed sympathetically as a central love story, but framed within tragedy. Source text labels her lesbian/queer, but as a woman in a marriage to a man who loves a woman, 'queer' is used as the umbrella label absent clearer self-identification in the text.

queer_characters.name: Tallie
queer_characters.notes: Abigail's neighbor and lover, trapped in an abusive marriage to Finney. Her queerness is explicit in the physical affair with Abigail. Rep is mixed because the character dies, contributing to a tragic-queer arc. 'Queer' used as umbrella label since the text does not support a firmer self-identification.

contributor_notes: Won the Queer Lion at Venice 2020. Source text tags both leads as lesbian/queer, but since both are women married to men who fall in love with each other, I used the 'queer' umbrella label rather than 'lesbian' or 'bisexual' absent explicit self-identification in the provided text — a maintainer may wish to refine. Bury-your-gays and tragic-queer flagged because Tallie dies (allegedly of diphtheria) and the affair ends in loss. Content warnings cover Finney's domestic abuse of Tallie and Tallie's death; grief over a child's death is also present but not mapped to an available warning enum.
